title: William Timmons highlights GOP priorities on voter ID, tax policy, and DC legislation - Greenville Leader
text:
Congressman William Timmons, who represents South Carolina’s 4th district in the U.S. House of Representatives, recently used his social media platform to comment on issues ranging from election integrity to federal spending and public safety in Washington, D.C.
On March 23, 2026, Timmons questioned Democratic opposition to certain voting requirements by posting: “Democrats will fight Voter ID. They’ll fight proof of citizenship. They’ll fight election integrity. Ask yourself why.”
The following day, on March 24, 2026, he referenced proposed fiscal policy changes, stating: “$500 BILLION in savings. No more taxpayer-funded benefits for illegal immigrants. No more fraud and loopholes. The Working Families Tax Cuts put American taxpayers first. “
On March 25, 2026, Timmons highlighted a recent legislative development with: ” House Republicans just passed H.R. 5103, the Make the District of Columbia Safe and Beautiful Act. This codifies President Trump’s Executive Order and establishes the D.C. Safe and Beautiful Commission. Washington is safer and cleaner thanks to @POTUS and @HouseGOP. “
William Timmons has served in Congress since 2019 after replacing Trey Gowdy as representative for South Carolina’s 4th district; prior to that he was a member of the South Carolina Senate from 2016 to 2018. Born in Greenville in 1984 and currently residing there at age 38, Timmons holds degrees from George Washington University (BA) and the University of South Carolina (JD).
